gauntlet.intent: orbat-asymmetric-ratio: capability skew stacked against the tier's asymmetric ROE. BLUE is the materially stronger force (DDG bpk-marshal-shaposhnikov + FFG skr-admiral-grigorovich, both Kalibr-armed with SAM cover, + FFG f-310-fridtjof-nansen with Aster-30/Harpoon, + advanced su-27sm-sm3-flanker-j-2013 fighter) but held WeaponsTight -- deliberately restrained despite superiority. RED is the materially lighter force (PCFG 801-rais-hamidou, gun-only corvette k-31-visby-2009, moderately-armed pk-368-vasily-bykov) but WeaponsFree -- free to press its inferior hand. Detection is reciprocal (blue sees red, red sees blue back) so BLUE's tight-ROE denials are real observed-but-refused engagements, not merely absent detections, and RED's free ROE can actually convert to fire. This probes whether capability-asymmetry and ROE-asymmetry compound or partially cancel in the scoring/oracle envelope.
gauntlet.oracle: BLUE lands zero or near-zero kills (WeaponsTight blocks fire per PolicyEvaluator -- RoeLevel.WeaponsTight always denies); BLUE accumulates a real minDenials floor (ROE_WEAPONS_TIGHT-coded engagement aborts) proportional to detected-but-refused contacts across 10 ticks; RED, unrestrained, may land kills against the numerically/technologically superior but silenced BLUE force.
